name: WF-452 — Forecast Gap → Acquisition Capacity, Lead Volume & Budget Scaling Controller

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const portfolioId=String(b.portfolioId??'').trim(); const period=String(b.period??'').trim(); const asOfDate=String(b.asOfDate??new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)).trim(); return [{json:{...b,portfolioId,period,asOfDate,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Forecast Gap Request').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const n=v=>Number.isFinite(Number(v))?Number(v):0; const forecast=ctx.forecast??{}; const target=ctx.target??ctx.targets??{}; const capacity=ctx.capacity??{}; const flags=[]; const projectedLeads=n(forecast.projectedLeads??forecast.leads); const projectedQualified=n(forecast.projectedQualifiedLeads??forecast.qualifiedLeads); const projectedContracts=n(forecast.projectedContracts??forecast.contracts); const projectedClosed=n(forecast.projectedClosedDeals??forecast.closedDeals); const projectedProfit=n(forecast.projectedNetProfit??forecast.netProfit); const projectedSpend=n(forecast.projectedAcquisitionSpend??forecast.acquisitionSpend); const targetLeads=n(target.leads??target.targetLeads); const targetQualified=n(target.qualifiedLeads); const targetContracts=n(target.contracts); const targetClosed=n(target.closedDeals); const targetProfit=n(target.netProfit); const targetSpend=n(target.acquisitionBudget??target.acquisitionSpend); const gaps={leads:Math.max(0,targetLeads-projectedLeads),qualifiedLeads:Math.max(0,targetQualified-projectedQualified),contracts:Math.max(0,targetContracts-projectedContracts),closedDeals:Math.max(0,targetClosed-projectedClosed),netProfit:Math.max(0,targetProfit-projectedProfit)}; const rates={qualifiedPerLead:projectedLeads>0?projectedQualified/projectedLeads:0,contractsPerQualified:projectedQualified>0?projectedContracts/projectedQualified:0,closedPerContract:projectedContracts>0?projectedClosed/projectedContracts:0,profitPerClosed:projectedClosed>0?projectedProfit/projectedClosed:0,spendPerLead:projectedLeads>0?projectedSpend/projectedLeads:0}; const neededLeadsForClosed=gaps.closedDeals>0&&rates.closedPerContract>0&&rates.contractsPerQualified>0&&rates.qualifiedPerLead>0?gaps.closedDeals/(rates.closedPerContract*rates.contractsPerQualified*rates.qualifiedPerLead):0; const incrementalLeads=Math.max(gaps.leads,neededLeadsForClosed); const incrementalBudget=incrementalLeads*rates.spendPerLead; const queueCapacity=n(capacity.availableLeadCapacity??capacity.availableCapacity); const capacityUtilization=n(capacity.currentUtilization); const capacityShortfall=Math.max(0,incrementalLeads-queueCapacity); if(capacityShortfall>0)flags.push('lead_handling_capacity_shortfall'); if(projectedSpend>targetSpend&&targetSpend>0)flags.push('acquisition_budget_already_over_target'); let decision='maintain_current_capacity'; const actions=[]; if(incrementalLeads>0){if(capacityShortfall>0){decision='increase_lead_capacity_before_scaling_acquisition';actions.push('add_or_rebalance_follow_up_and_lead_routing_capacity');actions.push('prioritize_hot_and_high_probability_leads');}else if(incrementalBudget>0){decision='scale_acquisition_with_capacity_guardrails';actions.push('increase_acquisition_budget_only_within_approved_limits');actions.push('increase_lead_generation_to_close_forecast_gap');}else{decision='improve_conversion_before_increasing_spend';actions.push('improve_qualification_offer_and_close_rate');}}else if(projectedProfit>=targetProfit&&targetProfit>0){decision='maintain_and_optimize';actions.push('maintain_current_acquisition_capacity');}else{actions.push('monitor_forecast_and_pipeline_capacity');} if(capacityUtilization>=0.9)actions.push('protect_response_sla_by_rebalancing_or_adding_capacity'); if(projectedSpend>targetSpend&&targetSpend>0)actions.push('reallocate_existing_budget_before_adding_spend'); const idempotencyKey='wf452:'+input.portfolioId+':'+input.period+':'+input.asOfDate; return [{json:{...input,forecastGapScaling:{status:flags.length?'guarded':'ready',decision,projected:{leads:projectedLeads,qualifiedLeads:projectedQualified,contracts:projectedContracts,closedDeals:projectedClosed,netProfit:projectedProfit,acquisitionSpend:projectedSpend},targets:{leads:targetLeads,qualifiedLeads:targetQualified,contracts:targetContracts,closedDeals:targetClosed,netProfit:targetProfit,acquisitionSpend:targetSpend},gaps,rates,incrementalLeadsRequired:Math.ceil(incrementalLeads),incrementalBudgetRequired:Math.round(incrementalBudget*100)/100,availableLeadCapacity:queueCapacity,capacityUtilization,capacityShortfall,actions,flags,requiresHumanReview:flags.length>0,confidenceScore:flags.length?65:85},idempotencyKey}}];

meta.notes: Converts forecast gaps into incremental lead and budget requirements while checking lead-handling capacity and protecting response SLAs. Production use requires calibrated funnel rates, verified queue/assignee capacity, approved budget limits, canonical spend data and production InsulaCRM API contracts.
